title: Diamondfire Core
description: DiamondFire Core is an unofficial, lightweight modpack built for DiamondFire, focused on signal-based logic, clean systems, and efficient event handling.
body: **DiamondFire Core** is an unofficial, lightweight modpack built for DiamondFire, focused on signal-based logic, clean systems, and efficient event handling. This modpack also includes CodeClient, providing additional tools for scripting, code editing, and improved development workflows within DiamondFire.
